awards_draft#u1.rationale: Five series are NO_MARKETS_LISTED/TITLE_ONLY and the sampled award texts lack tie and injury-replacement clauses; only Kalshi listing or clarifying the rules resolves it.

awards_draft#u2.rationale: Voter-level ballots are released only after announcement and strategic voting is unobservable in season; the vote input is defined but its source is coverage-limited.

awards_draft#u3.rationale: 2026-27 award eligibility thresholds (65-game/20-minute rule, positionless All-NBA) and which awards they govern are recalled from memory; these are published league rules the author can read.
awards_draft#u3.catalog_action: Read the 2023 CBA award-eligibility article and the NBA's 2026-27 award criteria release; record each threshold and the list of covered awards with citations in the awards_draft record.

awards_draft#u4.rationale: Whether Kalshi settles on a reporter leak or the official announcement is a settlement-source question the sampled award texts do not answer; it needs Kalshi's wording or clarification.

awards_draft#u5.rationale: All-Star selection weights (50/25/25), starter/reserve split and wildcard rules are recalled, not read; the league publishes the 2027 selection rules, so this is lookup research.
awards_draft#u5.catalog_action: Read the NBA's 2027 All-Star voting and selection release; record vote weights, positional splits, reserve/replacement rules and whether fan-vote returns are archived, with citations.

awards_draft#u6.rationale: The Hustle Award is decided by tracked hustle stats that no catalog input aggregates, and Teammate/Sportsmanship rely only on a generic nominee model: a missing input.
awards_draft#u6.catalog_action: Author an input aggregating the Hustle Award's published hustle-stat formula (deflections, charges, loose balls, screen assists, contests) and define vote-process inputs for Teammate and Sportsmanship.

awards_draft#u7.rationale: Draft-slot and award texts say nothing on rescheduled drafts, forfeited picks or whether league eligibility rulings bind; that wording is absent from the sampled Kalshi rules.

awards_draft#u8.rationale: Hall of Fame election procedure (finalist timing, 18-of-24 threshold, direct-elect committees) and player-vote award procedures are recalled; the Hall and league publish them.
awards_draft#u8.catalog_action: Read the Naismith Hall of Fame's current election rules and the NBA's 2026-27 Social Justice/Teammate/Sportsmanship procedure releases; record thresholds, dates and electorates with citations.

combo_props#u1.rationale: KXNBAPRA/PROT texts do not state overtime inclusion and KXNBAPR/KXNBAPA have NO_MARKETS_LISTED, so their DNP/OT wording is unavailable until Kalshi lists or clarifies.

combo_props#u2.rationale: Potential assists and rebound chances are defined inputs, but per-game tracking rows are paid or rate-limited and the free endpoint's game grain is unverified from here.

combo_props#u3.rationale: The minutes-regime thresholds (margin 18, 4 fouls by Q3) are judgement placeholders in the input definition; they can be set from free minutes and play-by-play histograms.
combo_props#u3.catalog_action: Derive blowout/foul/OT/restriction regime cutoffs from free play-by-play minute histograms (by coach where supported) and replace the judgement thresholds in the minutes-mixture input definition.

combo_props#u4.rationale: How lineup-conditional rates shrink toward season averages for new rosters and traded players is undefined; the shrinkage schedule is a definition gap researchable on past seasons.
combo_props#u4.catalog_action: Define a shrinkage rule for lineup-conditional component rates as a function of shared possessions/roster age, calibrated on past seasons' new combinations, and add it to the input.

combo_props#u5.rationale: The referee-crew input is defined and assignments are published each game day, but point-in-time history with publication timestamps requires our own daily capture of the assignments page.

combo_props#u6.rationale: No input quantifies rest/load-management probability (back-to-backs, restrictions, clinched rest) that shifts minutes-mixture weights; this is a missing mechanism.
combo_props#u6.catalog_action: Author a rest/load-management probability input from the NBA player participation policy and historical DNP-rest/minutes-restriction patterns, and wire it into the minutes mixture weights.

combo_props#u7.rationale: The protected clause's entry-timing wording is cut mid-sentence in the sample and KXNBAPR/KXNBAPA are unlisted; full clause text or a Kalshi worked example is required.

first_basket#u1.rationale: No NBA first-basket or first-team-to-score series is listed, so free-throw, tip-in, non-playing-player and cancellation treatment cannot be read from any Kalshi text.

first_basket#u2.rationale: Opening-play set labels are defined but exist only in paid play-type feeds or video; the free proxy is first-six-minute usage, a source-coverage limit.

first_basket#u3.rationale: The jumper-skill slope (0.1) in the tip-win input is an assumption; tip outcomes and jumpers are in free play-by-play jump-ball events, so it is researchable.
first_basket#u3.catalog_action: Estimate the tip-win logit on jumper identity/height from 5 seasons of free play-by-play jump-ball events and replace the assumed 0.1 slope in the tip input.

first_basket#u4.rationale: Starting-lineup confirmation is a defined input, but pre-tip announcement timestamps are not archived by free sources, so the vintage must be captured live going forward.

first_basket#u5.rationale: No Kalshi first-basket/first-score series exists in the ledger; whether such a contract exists and its terms depend entirely on Kalshi listing one.

game_moneyline_spread#u1.rationale: KXNBASPREAD text settles on the official final result but does not state overtime, Cup-final/play-in coverage or score-correction handling; only Kalshi wording resolves this.

game_moneyline_spread#u2.rationale: The impact-metric input is defined, but whether free EPM/DARKO/RAPM sources expose point-in-time vintages is unverified; end-of-season values would leak look-ahead.

game_moneyline_spread#u3.rationale: The record carries a referee-crew margin effect without evidence it exists; estimating a crew random effect on margin residuals from free box scores closes it.
game_moneyline_spread#u3.catalog_action: Estimate a crew random effect on game-margin and home-advantage residuals over 5 seasons of free box scores; keep or drop the officiating input for margin with the estimate recorded.

game_moneyline_spread#u4.rationale: Coach-level rotation priors (resting stars in blowouts, rotation tightening) are named as the fix but no such input is defined in the catalog.
game_moneyline_spread#u4.catalog_action: Author a coach-level rotation/blowout-pull prior input built from five seasons of free minutes and play-by-play data and attach it to the margin model.

game_moneyline_spread#u5.rationale: Elimination/adjustment effects inside playoff series are carried by an unsized input and ownership of series-level tickers versus series_and_cup is unconfirmed.
game_moneyline_spread#u5.catalog_action: Estimate elimination, adjustment and rest effects in playoff games from 10 seasons of playoff results, and record in the catalog that series_and_cup owns the series-level inputs.

game_moneyline_spread#u6.rationale: Home-court value (~2 pts), margin sd (~12) and the 6% OT rate are stated unsourced in the record; all are computable from free team-game logs.
game_moneyline_spread#u6.catalog_action: Compute home advantage by season, margin sd by pace bucket and overtime rate from 10 seasons of free game logs and replace the recalled values with sourced ones.

game_overtime_and_team_events#u1.rationale: Head-to-head texts say 'full game' without stating overtime or defining bench, and KXNBAOVERTIME/SERIESOT lack postponement clauses in the sampled text.

game_overtime_and_team_events#u2.rationale: The tie-mass excess factor kappa (1.7-1.9) is recalled from literature, not sourced; it is estimable from free line scores, so the record's value is unsupported.
game_overtime_and_team_events#u2.catalog_action: Estimate kappa (regulation-tie mass over Gaussian) from 15 seasons of free line scores, check stability across late-game rule changes, and record it in the OT input.

game_overtime_and_team_events#u3.rationale: Intentional-foul tagging is a defined input but free play-by-play has no intent flag; inference from foul type and clock has misclassification, a source limitation.

game_overtime_and_team_events#u4.rationale: Whether bench points use the official starting five or a vendor starter flag, and whether OT counts, is not stated in the KXNBAH2HBENCHPTS text; Kalshi must clarify.

game_overtime_and_team_events#u5.rationale: No input converts rest, back-to-back or playoff rotation tightening into bench share; a missing mechanism for bench-points contracts.
game_overtime_and_team_events#u5.catalog_action: Author a bench-share input conditioned on rest days, back-to-back and playoff status (controlling for margin) from 5 seasons of free box scores.

game_overtime_and_team_events#u6.rationale: Beyond silent settlement text, the within-series correlation of close games that drives the 3+ OT-games tail is not defined as an input; that interaction is missing.
game_overtime_and_team_events#u6.catalog_action: Define a within-series dependence input for overtime-game counts and estimate its dispersion from 20+ seasons of playoff line scores; note threshold/incomplete-series wording as a Kalshi question.

game_overtime_and_team_events#u7.rationale: P(2nd OT|OT), OT points and bench-points mean/sd are recalled and possibly understated; all are computable from free line scores and box scores.
game_overtime_and_team_events#u7.catalog_action: Compute multi-OT conditional rates, OT point totals and bench points/minutes from 15 seasons of free line and box scores; replace recalled values in the record.

game_total#u1.rationale: KXNBATOTAL text says 'total points scored in the game' with no overtime statement; OT inclusion is inferred, and only Kalshi's rulebook or clarification settles it.

game_total#u2.rationale: The pace-composition rule (slower team controls vs additive) is unestimated in the input definition; free possession data allows the regression.
game_total#u2.catalog_action: Estimate the pace-composition regression on several seasons of free team-game possessions, test era effects, and fix the composition formula in the pace input.

game_total#u3.rationale: Transition and play-type frequencies are defined inputs but only paid feeds (Synergy, Second Spectrum) carry them; free fast-break proxies are crude.

game_total#u4.rationale: Referee assignments are published on game day; a machine-readable point-in-time archive is unverified, so we must snapshot assignments daily going forward.

game_total#u7.rationale: Crew effect size, game total sd, cross term and OT block are recalled numbers in the record; each is estimable from free game logs and crew data.
game_total#u7.catalog_action: Estimate crew-season random effects on totals, the total sd and the OT points block from 10 seasons of free results and replace the recalled magnitudes.

game_win_margin#u1.rationale: Only one KXNBAWINMARGIN market was sampled, so band edges, open top band, side listing and OT inclusion are not visible in Kalshi text.

game_win_margin#u2.rationale: The OT/parity corrections to the margin pmf are recalled, not measured; free game results over 10 seasons allow direct estimation.
game_win_margin#u2.catalog_action: Estimate the overtime and parity corrections to the margin pmf on 10 seasons of free results, test breaks around clutch/foul rule changes, and record the values.

game_win_margin#u3.rationale: Starter pull times are a defined input, but free play-by-play has known clock/substitution errors; clean timestamps need video audit or paid tracking.

game_win_margin#u4.rationale: The link from seeding stakes/rest policy to pull timing is acknowledged but not defined as an input; a missing mechanism.
game_win_margin#u4.catalog_action: Define an input for starter pull time as a function of standings stakes, rest and coach, estimated from free play-by-play substitutions.

off_court_events#u1.rationale: Source Agencies, re-signing as 'joining', schedule-change effects and truncated KXNBANEXTCONTRACT/APOLOGY tails are unstated in sampled Kalshi text.

off_court_events#u2.rationale: Owner meetings, negotiations and trade talks are inherently private; the inputs (leak-based hazards, reference classes) are defined but the raw information is inaccessible.

off_court_events#u3.rationale: The Board of Governors approval threshold and expansion timelines are recalled, not read; the league constitution and recent decisions are lookup research.
off_court_events#u3.catalog_action: Read the NBA constitution/bylaws on expansion and relocation votes and coverage of recent approvals; record the vote threshold and tabulate process durations.

off_court_events#u4.rationale: Expansion, conference realignment and European-league decisions are linked but modelled as independent; the joint dependence is a missing interaction.
off_court_events#u4.catalog_action: Author a joint scenario input linking KXNBACITYEXPAND, KXNBAJOINCONF and KXNBAEUROPEANNOUNCE outcomes from league statements and board calendars.

off_court_events#u5.rationale: Player-trade, relocation and retirement reference classes use a pooled base rate with undefined window lengths; the input definition is incomplete.
off_court_events#u5.catalog_action: Define per-family reference classes (trade, relocation, retirement) with explicit event definitions and windows, replacing the pooled nba.offfield_base_rate for those series.

off_court_events#u6.rationale: Report-to-event conversion, retirement hazards, stage completion rates and the approval threshold are recalled numbers; compiling public deal/retirement history sources them.
off_court_events#u6.catalog_action: Compile 10 years of reported deals and retirements by report stage and outcome from public coverage and replace the recalled hazard numbers with sourced rates.

off_court_events#u7.rationale: Max-contract tiers, designated-veteran criteria and the cap projection are recalled from the 2023 CBA; the CBA and league cap releases are readable.
off_court_events#u7.catalog_action: Read the CBA maximum-salary and designated-veteran articles and the league's latest salary-cap projection; update nba.next_contract_value_model with cited values.

parlay_combo#u1.rationale: KXNBAPREPACK2ML/3ML texts have no postponement or void-leg clause and no same-game player-combo series is listed; settlement of voided legs needs Kalshi wording.

parlay_combo#u2.rationale: Pairwise player-leg dependence is defined via role factors; per-pair history is too short and sportsbook correlations are proprietary, a coverage limit no source fixes.

parlay_combo#u3.rationale: The copula family (Gaussian vs t/mixture) governing tail dependence is unresolved in the input definition; free box scores allow a held-out comparison.
parlay_combo#u3.catalog_action: Compare Gaussian, t and mixture copulas on held-out joint leg outcomes from free box scores and fix the dependence family in the parlay input.

parlay_combo#u4.rationale: How rest/schedule shocks create a common minutes reduction across legs is not defined; a missing common-shock mechanism.
parlay_combo#u4.catalog_action: Define a rest-state indicator and its loading on the shared minutes factor, separated from the injury shock, in the parlay dependence input.

parlay_combo#u5.rationale: Leg count, nested/implied legs and fixed vs chosen thresholds are unknown because no combination series rules are listed; Kalshi must publish them.

parlay_combo#u6.rationale: All same-game dependence figures and the near-zero cross-game assumption are recalled; free box scores allow estimating them.
parlay_combo#u6.catalog_action: Estimate same-game factor loadings and same-day cross-game residual correlations from 10 seasons of free box scores and replace the recalled figures.

parlay_combo#u7.rationale: KXNBANHL needs a Stanley Cup probability that no NBA catalog input defines; the cross-sport input linkage is missing.
parlay_combo#u7.catalog_action: Define a cross-sport input referencing the NHL catalog's championship probability by id with a matching as-of timestamp for KXNBANHL.

player_assists#u1.rationale: Potential assists/time of possession are defined but leaguedashptstats is season-aggregate; game-grain rows are only a date-filter workaround, unverified from here.

player_assists#u2.rationale: Pass-lane quality and defender distance are held only in licensed tracking data; the input is defined and the model must proxy it.

player_assists#u3.rationale: Selection from the zero-minute void and the early-exit hazard's rest-in-blowout component are unquantified and unvalidated for guards; researchable from free play-by-play.
player_assists#u3.catalog_action: Estimate zero-minute and early-exit rates per player from free play-by-play, validate nba.early_exit_hazard for guards, and document the void selection effect.

player_assists#u4.rationale: The arena scorer-credit offset for assists is estimated from few seasons with unknown stability; more seasons of free box scores can size it.
player_assists#u4.catalog_action: Estimate arena assist-credit offsets over 6 seasons with shrinkage and test stability across scorer turnover; record the result in the assist input.

player_assists#u5.rationale: KXNBAAST/ASTPROT texts omit overtime and the protected secondary text is truncated mid-sentence, so inactive-player and OT wording is unseen.

player_availability#u1.rationale: KXNBAPLAYTOGETHER has no listed rules and RETURN/COMPETE texts omit suspensions and protests; the meaning of 'play together' depends on Kalshi text.

player_availability#u2.rationale: The archetype is labelled game-level starter/active status while live contracts are season-level one-offs; the archetype definition is mis-scoped.
player_availability#u2.catalog_action: Re-scope the player_availability archetype to the live season-level series (return, compete, play-together) and file game-level status as conditional on a series listing.

player_availability#u3.rationale: Starter retention, return-date slippage and status-to-play rates are recalled priors; official injury reports and box scores allow computing them.
player_availability#u3.catalog_action: Compute starter retention, return slippage and status-label play rates from 10 seasons of archived injury reports and box scores; replace recalled priors.

player_availability#u4.rationale: Training-camp lineup and minute plans are closed information available only via reporters; the opener input is defined but its source is coverage-limited.

player_availability#u5.rationale: The unsigned-veteran signing hazard has only qualitative camp/injury/buyout bumps; transaction history allows fitting it.
player_availability#u5.catalog_action: Fit a discrete-time signing hazard for unsigned veterans on 10 seasons of public transactions with age, minutes and injury covariates; define it in nba.unsigned_player_signing_hazard.

player_availability#u6.rationale: Whether KXNBACOMPETE's 'any regular season game' includes the NBA Cup final is not stated in the sampled text; Kalshi must clarify.

player_escalator_payout#u1.rationale: Escalator non-appearance treatment and any protected variant are not visible; rules_primary is truncated and secondary only covers zero points.

player_escalator_payout#u2.rationale: The beta-binomial dispersion rho driving the tail is recalled and debated; free shot logs allow estimating it against a shot-quality-adjusted binomial.
player_escalator_payout#u2.catalog_action: Estimate within-game make dispersion rho on 5 seasons of free shot logs with shot-quality adjustment and record it in the escalator distribution input.

player_escalator_payout#u3.rationale: Schedule-driven heavy-minute probability (rest, back-to-back, playoff race) is not defined as an input; a missing mechanism.
player_escalator_payout#u3.catalog_action: Add rest, back-to-back and standings terms to the heavy-minutes component input, estimated on free minutes data, separated from game closeness.

player_escalator_payout#u4.rationale: The extreme tail is defined, but per-player top-1% events are inherently rare; no public dataset enlarges the sample, so pooling is unavoidable.

player_escalator_payout#u5.rationale: Five numeric priors (rho, heavy-minutes share, attempt sd, minutes-attempts correlation, recency weight) are recalled; free player-game shot logs source them.
player_escalator_payout#u5.catalog_action: Estimate the five escalator priors from 5 seasons of free player-game shot logs and replace the recalled values in the record.

player_free_throws#u1.rationale: KXNBAFTM rules omit OT, technical/flagrant free throws, stat corrections, postponement and inactive-before-tip treatment; only Kalshi text resolves it.

player_free_throws#u2.rationale: How teammate absence enters free-throw volume (usage shift vs trip rate) is not defined in the attached inputs; an incomplete mechanism.
player_free_throws#u2.catalog_action: Define the teammate-absence pathway to free-throw trips (usage vs drive/trip rate) and test it on free box scores with nba.teammate_absence_shift.

player_free_throws#u3.rationale: Drive-contact and intentional-foul identification is defined but inferred from free play-by-play foul labels; validation needs a paid contact-tagged feed.

player_free_throws#u4.rationale: The FT%-3P% slope (0.5) and 80-attempt prior strength are recalled placeholders; free player shooting data allows estimating them.
player_free_throws#u4.catalog_action: Estimate the FT%-to-3P% relation and prior strength on 10 seasons of players with 100+ FTA and 3PA; replace the placeholders.

player_free_throws#u5.rationale: Only one KXNBAFTM market was sampled, so rung sets per player and low-rung listings are not visible in Kalshi text.

player_h2h_series_stats#u1.rationale: H2H texts say 'full game' without overtime and leader texts omit partial participation and forfeit handling; Kalshi wording is required.

player_h2h_series_stats#u2.rationale: Game-level playoff matchup data is defined, but leagueseasonmatchups is a season aggregate and game grain is unverified from here; input downgraded to context.

player_h2h_series_stats#u3.rationale: Pair-type correlations, tie masses and series-length means are recalled; all are computable from free box scores and playoff results.
player_h2h_series_stats#u3.catalog_action: Estimate pair-type stat correlations, tie masses and series-length means from 5+ seasons of free box scores and playoff series; replace the recalled values.

player_h2h_series_stats#u4.rationale: How shooting luck is shrunk across games of a series and for low-attempt shooters is not defined in the attached regression input.
player_h2h_series_stats#u4.catalog_action: Define series-level shrinkage of shooting luck in nba.player_shooting_regression, including low-attempt shooters, and test it on free playoff box scores.

player_h2h_series_stats#u5.rationale: Tie-at-top frequencies and per-game hit correlations that drive leader and every-game contracts are not estimated; free playoff game logs allow it.
player_h2h_series_stats#u5.catalog_action: Estimate tie-at-top frequencies and per-game hit correlations from 20 seasons of free playoff player game logs and add them as inputs.

player_milestones#pm-boxscore-endpoint-s.rationale: The player-game box-score input is defined; whether nba_api boxscoretraditionalv2 stays populated for 2026-27 (vs v3) is a source-availability question unverified from here.

player_milestones#pm-fair-price-definiti.rationale: KXNBA2D/3D 'fair price' void payout is undefined in the sampled text; only the protected rebound text ties it to pre-tip price. Kalshi must define it.

player_milestones#pm-ot-inclusion.rationale: KXNBA2D/3D secondary text defines double/triple doubles and void rules but not overtime, and is truncated before source agencies.

player_milestones#pm-playoff3d-scope.rationale: KXNBAPLAYOFF3D text does not say if Play-In counts, whether OT counts or how a pre-playoff trade/ruling-out settles; Kalshi wording is required.

player_milestones#pm-situational-gap.rationale: No input captures back-to-back, post-injury ramp-up or seeding rest effects on DD probability beyond projected minutes; a missing mechanism.
player_milestones#pm-situational-gap.catalog_action: Author a rest/restriction-state input (back-to-back, post-injury ramp, clinch status) and test projected-minutes error by state on free data.

player_milestones#pm-stat-chase-size.rationale: Teammate stat-chase gifting near 10 is asserted without an estimate; pooled free play-by-play can test whether the multiplier differs from 1.
player_milestones#pm-stat-chase-size.catalog_action: Estimate the near-milestone gifting multiplier from 3 seasons of free play-by-play with empirical Bayes across coaches and record keep/drop.

player_milestones#pm-tracking-access.rationale: Rebound chances and potential assists are defined inputs, but event-level tracking is licensed; free endpoints expose aggregates only.

player_points#pp-bucket-mixing.rationale: The archetype mixes player ladders with KXNBABENCHPTS, apparently a team-level sum; the filing is wrong regardless of its unlisted rules.
player_points#pp-bucket-mixing.catalog_action: Move KXNBABENCHPTS beside team_total/game_overtime bench inputs (team bench sum) or define its player-level reading, and record the decision in the catalog.

player_points#pp-defender-distance.rationale: Shot quality is defined on zone/action; defender-distance bins by shot type may exist only in paid tracking, unverified from here.

player_points#pp-ot-inclusion.rationale: KXNBAPTS/PROT texts never say overtime points count, while a sibling series says 'including overtime' explicitly; Kalshi wording is needed.

player_points#pp-situational.rationale: No input models stars' rest-for-seeding and minutes restrictions outside the injury report; a missing mechanism in late-season minute scenarios.
player_points#pp-situational.catalog_action: Author a rest-for-seeding/minutes-restriction input from clinch status and rest days, validated by back-testing minutes error on free data.

player_points#pp-titleonly.rationale: KXNBALADDERPTS and KXNBABENCHPTS have no listed markets, so their void rule and bench definition cannot be read; Kalshi must list them.

player_rebounds#pr-leakage-source.rationale: The 6-10% team-rebound leakage figure is an unsourced hypothesis in the creditable-pool rationale; free box scores report team rebounds, so it is computable.
player_rebounds#pr-leakage-source.catalog_action: Reconcile team versus player rebounds from free box-score and play-by-play endpoints over several seasons and replace the hypothesized leakage share.

player_rebounds#pr-ot-inclusion.rationale: KXNBAREB/PROT settle on 'rebounds recorded' without stating overtime; OT is mentioned only in the protected appearance definition.

player_rebounds#pr-situational.rationale: No input handles rest-for-seeding and post-injury minutes ramps for bigs; a missing mechanism.
player_rebounds#pr-situational.catalog_action: Author a rest/ramp-up state input and back-test projected-minutes error for bigs by rest and clinch status on free data.

player_rebounds#pr-tracking-access.rationale: Rebound chances and box-outs are defined inputs, but licensed tracking with per-game vintages is unavailable from free dashboards (season aggregates only).

player_threes#p3-assist-linkage.rationale: The passer map is defined; assist ids exist on made shots but missed-shot passer linkage is absent from free feeds, a source limitation.

player_threes#p3-defender-distance.rationale: Openness is rebased on zone/action; whether dated defender-distance bins and catch-and-shoot crosses are public for 2026-27 is unverified from here.

player_threes#p3-hothand.rationale: Within-game shooting persistence is not represented by any input; whether to include it needs a test on free shot logs.
player_threes#p3-hothand.catalog_action: Estimate within-game make autocorrelation conditional on shot zone/action from multiple seasons of free shot logs and add or reject a hot-hand input.

player_threes#p3-ot-inclusion.rationale: KXNBA3PT/PROT settle on 'made three-pointers recorded' without stating overtime; Kalshi wording or clarification is required.

player_threes#p3-situational.rationale: No variable captures rest/travel effects on three-point makes or rest-for-seeding minute cuts; a missing mechanism.
player_threes#p3-situational.catalog_action: Author a rest/travel state input for three-point attempts and makes and back-test residual 3P% by schedule state on free data.

player_threes#p3-titleonly.rationale: KXNBALADDER3PT has no listed markets, so whether it uses cumulative N+ rungs and the KXNBA3PT void rule is unknowable from Kalshi text.

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-2h-ot-split.rationale: Texts are explicit; what is missing is an input producing regulation-only and OT-inclusive second-half margins jointly from one simulation.
quarter_and_half_markets#qh-2h-ot-split.catalog_action: Define the OT-inclusive 2H margin as regulation 2H margin plus an OT increment from nba.ot_prob_ratings_margin in a joint input.

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-lineup-data.rationale: Lineup-unit ratings are defined, but long lineup history needs pbpstats or licensed feeds; free coverage is partial and rate-limited.

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-live-state.rationale: If later-period markets trade after tip, in-game state inputs (score, on-court, bonus, clock) are needed and none exist; close_time is a checkable listing field.
quarter_and_half_markets#qh-live-state.catalog_action: Read close_time for Q2-Q4/2H markets via the Kalshi API; if they trade in-play, author a live-state input set (period-start score, on-court units, bonus, clock).

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-q3-effect.rationale: Coach Q3 adjustment effects are carried without evidence of persistence; free quarter scores allow estimating the variance component.
quarter_and_half_markets#qh-q3-effect.catalog_action: Estimate the coach Q3-effect variance component across seasons from free quarter scores and test out-of-sample persistence; keep or drop the input.

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-start-timing.rationale: Starters input is defined; whether confirmation precedes market close needs timestamped starter confirmations captured prospectively against close times.

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-strike-const.rationale: Sampled period strikes (71.5, 70.5) look like ladder rungs; the live strike set is not visible in sampled Kalshi listings. A full period distribution covers any strike.

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-titleonly.rationale: KXNBA1QTEAMTOTAL/4QTEAMTOTAL have no listed markets and quarter texts print no postponement sentence; Kalshi must list or clarify.

race_to_and_points_leader#rl-coaching-ga.rationale: Scripted openers and first-substitution timing affect a race to 30 but no input measures them; a missing mechanism.
race_to_and_points_leader#rl-coaching-ga.catalog_action: Author a coach first-stint input (points per possession, star first-sub timing) from free play-by-play and test persistence.

race_to_and_points_leader#rl-no-rules.rationale: KXNBARACE/PTSLEADER texts omit overtime and the never-reached case, and only N=30 was sampled; Kalshi wording/listings resolve it.

race_to_and_points_leader#rl-officiating.rationale: Crew early-foul effects on first-to-N or star minutes are not represented by any input; a missing mechanism to test.
race_to_and_points_leader#rl-officiating.catalog_action: Test crew foul-rate effects on first-stint free throws and star minutes from free play-by-play; add an officiating input if material.

race_to_and_points_leader#rl-race-scope.rationale: Whether other N values or player-based race variants are listed is not visible in the single sampled KXNBARACE event; depends on Kalshi listings.

race_to_and_points_leader#rl-tie-rule.rationale: Tie rule is known ($1/N) but the tied-maximum frequency the leader input must handle is unestimated; free box scores give it.
race_to_and_points_leader#rl-tie-rule.catalog_action: Compute historical tied points-maximum frequency by pregame expected-points gap from 5 seasons of free box scores and build it into nba.leader_share_by_usage_rank.

season_futures_team#sf-cup-rule.rationale: Cup-game counting and 2026-27 filler-game scheduling are assumed, not read; league Cup and schedule rules are published.
season_futures_team#sf-cup-rule.catalog_action: Read the NBA's 2026-27 Cup rules and schedule-completion release; record which games count and version the schedule once filler games are announced.

season_futures_team#sf-injury-data.rationale: Injury hazards are defined, but no clean multi-season point-in-time injury dataset is public; reconstruction from transaction archives is coverage-limited.

season_futures_team#sf-mixed-bucket.rationale: The MVP vote's dependence on team record (inside KXNBAMVPCHAMP) is not defined by any fitted input; a missing interaction.
season_futures_team#sf-mixed-bucket.catalog_action: Define an MVP conditional-logit input with team win percentage as covariate, fitted on 20 seasons of public voting results, linked to the team simulation.

season_futures_team#sf-seed-tie-edge.rationale: Seed contracts state no tie rule of their own and KXNBAPLAYOFFWINS omits incomplete series; Kalshi text does not confirm the tiebroken seed reading.

season_futures_team#sf-tiebreak-and-divi.rationale: The 2026-27 tiebreak order is assumed from past seasons and a duplicate tiebreak input exists; both are authoring fixes.
season_futures_team#sf-tiebreak-and-divi.catalog_action: Code the NBA's published 2026-27 tiebreak procedure into nba.tiebreak_ledger and mark nba.division_race_tiebreak_state DUPLICATE_OF it.

season_futures_team#sf-titleonly.rationale: KXNBANEWCHAMP has no listed markets so its franchise list is unknown, and win-total texts omit shortened-season rules.

season_stat_markets#ss-coaching-gap.rationale: Mid-season coaching changes and rest policies redefine star roles but no input measures their effect on season stat races.
season_stat_markets#ss-coaching-gap.catalog_action: Author a coaching-change/role-shift input from backtests of minutes and usage after past coaching changes on free data.

season_stat_markets#ss-gamespecials-scop.rationale: KXNBAGAMESPECIALS mixes events; secondary text references quarter markets excluding OT, so the other events' terms are not visible in sampled text.

season_stat_markets#ss-low-volume-three-.rationale: nba.three_volume's prior is undefined for near-zero-attempt players; the input definition is incomplete for KXNBAONE3PT.
season_stat_markets#ss-low-volume-three-.catalog_action: Define a hierarchical zero-inflated three-attempt model by position and coach for low-volume bigs, fitted on 10 seasons of free data.

season_stat_markets#ss-no-live-series.rationale: KXNBAHIGHESTSCORING and KXNBAPLAYERSPECIALS have no listed markets, so their settlement and tie rules are unknowable from Kalshi text.

season_stat_markets#ss-ownership-overlap.rationale: Streak contracts and win totals need one season simulation but two overlapping streak inputs lack a shared definition.
season_stat_markets#ss-ownership-overlap.catalog_action: Define one shared regular-season path simulation input and record nba.team_win_streak_hazard and nba.longest_streak_max_and_tie_model as views of it.

season_stat_markets#ss-rules-versioning.rationale: Source-agency rounding/correction policy and arena steal/block credit effects are unconfirmed; the policy is readable and credit effects estimable.
season_stat_markets#ss-rules-versioning.catalog_action: Read the stat providers' rounding and stat-correction policies and estimate arena steal/block credit effects from free play-by-play; record both.

series_and_cup#sc-archetype-mismatch.rationale: Cup contracts and comeback/blowout series contracts need different mechanisms and in-game score data; the archetype structure decision is unrecorded.
series_and_cup#sc-archetype-mismatch.catalog_action: Record the split (Cup stage vs series paths) and define in-game score inputs for KXNBASERIESGCOMEBACK and KXNBAFINBLOWOUT from free play-by-play.

series_and_cup#sc-coaching-gap.rationale: Playoff rotation shortening, in-series adjustments and Cup margin-chasing are not measured by any input; missing mechanisms.
series_and_cup#sc-coaching-gap.catalog_action: Author coach-level in-series adjustment and Cup margin-chasing inputs estimated from free playoff and Cup play-by-play.

series_and_cup#sc-comeback-definition.rationale: KXNBASERIESGCOMEBACK omits when the deficit is measured and KXNBAPOLOSE's title ('exactly') conflicts with its strike_type; Kalshi must clarify.

series_and_cup#sc-cup-bracket-structure.rationale: The Cup knockout bracket split, wildcard seeding and venues are assumed; the league's Cup format document is readable.
series_and_cup#sc-cup-bracket-structure.catalog_action: Read the NBA's 2026-27 Cup format; record bracket halves, wildcard seeding and venues, and bound the Finals-pair probability for shared-site correlation.

series_and_cup#sc-ot-venue-silence.rationale: Series texts omit overtime, neutral-site relocation and incomplete-series handling; only Kalshi's full rules or clarification resolves it.

series_and_cup#sc-ownership-overlap.rationale: Several archetypes consume series lengths and advancement but no single shared bracket simulation input is defined.
series_and_cup#sc-ownership-overlap.catalog_action: Define one shared playoff bracket simulation input and reference it from season_futures_team, player_milestones and playoff-points records.

series_and_cup#sc-titleonly.rationale: KXNBAPLAYOFFHOMEGAMES has no listed markets, so whether it matches KXNBAPLAYOFFHOST's 'actually hosted' and Play-In exclusion is unreadable.

steals_blocks_turnovers#sbt-credit-bias-.rationale: Arena scorer bias and the 0.1-0.2 dispersion index are unverified hypotheses in the record; free box scores allow estimating both.
steals_blocks_turnovers#sbt-credit-bias-.catalog_action: Estimate arena fixed effects on steals and blocks and the extra-dispersion index over 5 seasons of free box scores; replace the hypotheses.

steals_blocks_turnovers#sbt-hustle-acces.rationale: Deflection and rim-contest inputs are defined; per-game hustle rows via boxscorehustlev2 are unverified from here and may need paid tracking.

steals_blocks_turnovers#sbt-no-turnover-.rationale: No player-turnover series is listed on Kalshi, so its rules are unknown; own-turnover inputs are needed only if Kalshi lists one.

steals_blocks_turnovers#sbt-ot-inclusion.rationale: KXNBASTL/BLK/STOCK texts name the statistic but never say overtime counts; settlement reading needs Kalshi wording.

steals_blocks_turnovers#sbt-situational.rationale: Back-to-back fatigue and post-injury ramps on deflections/contests are not measured by any input; a missing mechanism.
steals_blocks_turnovers#sbt-situational.catalog_action: Author a rest-state input for activity rates and back-test steals/blocks per 36 by rest state on free data.

summer_league_games#sl-announcement-data.rationale: Who-plays announcements are defined inputs but have no structured archive; timestamped history must be captured live at future Summer Leagues.

summer_league_games#sl-efficiency-gap.rationale: Shrinkage of rookie shooting to a talent prior across the college-to-NBA line change is undefined; an input definition gap.
summer_league_games#sl-efficiency-gap.catalog_action: Define a rookie shooting translation input from college/G League to NBA three-point distance, fitted on historical rookies' public stats.

summer_league_games#sl-event-effects.rationale: Venue (Las Vegas vs Salt Lake) and event effects on scoring are not represented; past Summer League results allow estimating them.
summer_league_games#sl-event-effects.catalog_action: Estimate Summer League event/venue fixed effects on pace and scoring from public past results and add them as an input.

summer_league_games#sl-format-facts.rationale: Summer League game length, OT procedure and foul rules are assumed, not read; the league publishes them each year.
summer_league_games#sl-format-facts.catalog_action: Read the NBA's current Summer League rules release and record game length, overtime procedure and foul-out rules in the record.

summer_league_games#sl-no-series.rationale: Summer League game/spread/total texts omit overtime and cancellation; the MVP text names no voting body or co-winner rule.

team_total#tt-environment-gap.rationale: Venue effects on scoring (altitude, backdrop) have no input; free box scores allow estimating arena effects.
team_total#tt-environment-gap.catalog_action: Estimate arena fixed effects on points per possession controlling for teams from free data and add an environment input if material.

team_total#tt-ot-inclusion.rationale: Sampled team-total rules never mention overtime; whether OT points count is a Kalshi wording question that changes tail settlement.

team_total#tt-schedule-gap.rationale: Back-to-back and rest effects on team efficiency and pace are not represented by any input; a missing mechanism.
team_total#tt-schedule-gap.catalog_action: Author a rest-differential input for team offense and pace, estimated by back-testing residual team points on free game logs.

team_total#tt-strike-ladder.rationale: Sampled strike (135.5) implies a ladder, but the full strike set is not visible in sampled listings; the tail-quantile input already covers far rungs.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u1.rationale: KXNBAALLSTAR and SHOOTINGSTARS have one-line rules; formats, ties and team-change handling are unstated and ASG tiebreaks are silent.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u10.rationale: The Shooting Stars format (team size, spots, point values, rounds) is a published league fact missing from the record, blocking the skill simulation.
unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u10.catalog_action: Read the NBA's 2026 Shooting Stars format release and record team size, spots, point values, time limits, rounds and tie rules in the format ledger.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u2.rationale: 3PT rack/money-ball values, dunk scoring, ASG target-score and tiebreak formats are from memory; official format releases are readable.
unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u2.catalog_action: Read the NBA's official format releases for each event-year and record every format field with provenance in the format ledger.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u3.rationale: Round-score and judge models are defined but ball-by-ball and per-dunk judge scores lack a structured public table; video hand-coding is required.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u4.rationale: Exhibition effort/fatigue effects are defined as a concern, but the current-format sample is tiny; more seasons must accrue before estimation.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u5.rationale: No Celebrity Game series exists on Kalshi; its inputs and terms matter only if Kalshi lists one.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u6.rationale: Per-judge dunk scores may exist only on broadcast video and combine verticals are missing for some entrants; structured availability is unverified.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u7.rationale: Doubling-up fatigue, home-market entrants and crowd influence on judges are unmodelled for skills contests; missing mechanisms.
unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u7.catalog_action: Tag past entrants by doubling-up and home-market status and add contest-score adjustment inputs tested on past results.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u8.rationale: No blueprint fits the seven disjoint processes; whether to split the archetype or add an exhibition blueprint is undecided.
unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u8.catalog_action: Decide and author the archetype structure (contests, team exhibitions, MVP) or an exhibition blueprint, replacing ad-hoc per-series scoping.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u9.rationale: All-Star MVP selection method and scope (final vs whole tournament) are unverified though the NBA publishes them.
unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u9.catalog_action: Read the NBA's 2025-2026 All-Star MVP voting descriptions and record panel, fan-vote share and scope in the format ledger.

unreg:series_cumulative_points#u1.rationale: KXNBASERIESTOTALPTS/PTSSPREAD rules do not mention overtime; 'cumulative points' probably includes OT but Kalshi does not say.

unreg:series_cumulative_points#u2.rationale: Incomplete-series treatment, source of truth and early settlement on crossing the strike are absent from sampled Kalshi rules.

unreg:series_cumulative_points#u3.rationale: Only Finals events were sampled; strikes, mirror markets, spread orientation and earlier-round listings are not visible in Kalshi text.

unreg:series_cumulative_points#u4.rationale: Within-series correlation and game drift are defined, but only ~15 playoff series a season exist; the sample is inherently coverage-limited.

unreg:series_cumulative_points#u5.rationale: The whistle-regime input needs announcement-timed referee assignments; historical announcement times are not archived, so they must be captured going forward.

unreg:series_cumulative_points#u6.rationale: Series/game-number derivation is unconfirmed though the playoff game-id format is documented and checkable; the grouping rule is unauthored.
unreg:series_cumulative_points#u6.catalog_action: Verify the playoff game-id encoding (round, series, game) on leaguegamelog rows and author the series-grouping rule for 2004-present.

unreg:team_and_player_counting_specials#.rationale: Opponent doubling of hot scorers and coach willingness to play stars 45+ minutes are unmeasured but shift the 50-point tail.
unreg:team_and_player_counting_specials#.catalog_action: Author inputs for opponent double-team rate and star minutes ceiling in playoffs, estimated from free play-by-play.
